info.title: My Home Hero
info.synopsis: Tetsuo Tosu, un ordinario impiegato, scopre che sua figlia Reika è vittima degli abusi del fidanzato, Matori Nobuto. Mentre indaga per saperne di più sul suo conto, Tetsuo scopre che il suo obiettivo era quello di estorcere denaro ai nonni benestanti della giovane; il ragazzo, inoltre, fa parte di un'organizzazione criminale che ha causato la morte della sua ex fidanzata. Spinto dalla rabbia e dal desiderio di proteggere la figlia, l'uomo compie un gesto estremo che cambia completamente la sua vita.

episodes.title: Da oggi sono un assassino
episodes.synopsis: Tetsuo Tosu is a 47-year-old humble businessman who loves his family. He finds out that Reika, his daughter in college, has been physically abused by her boyfriend, Nobuto Matori, and acts to protect her, which leads to a terrible, irreparable situation.

episodes.title: Una cosa che ho fatto
episodes.synopsis: Tetsuo is allowed to walk away after Kyoichi is condemned by the organization. However, Kyoichi does not quietly accept his fate and attempts to escape his death sentence.

episodes.title: Padri
episodes.synopsis: Hearing the truth from Kyoichi, Matori visits Reika's apartment where Tetsuo happens to be. Just like on that fateful day, Tetsuo hides in the closet. Seeing the rage and sorrow of Matori, Tetsuo decides to ends it by confessing the crime to Matori.

episodes.title: La felicità di adesso
episodes.synopsis: Tetsuo and Matori remain locked in their fight to the death, both driven by their love for their families. Police come to investigate the noise created by the scuffle. The survivors are left to bury the bodies and bear the weight of their sins.
